22.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
22.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

23.meaning: A phrase meaning 'in/with that which' or 'in what' — combining the sense of 'by means of' or 'concerning' with an unspecified thing ('whatever it may be').
23.grammar: The preposition bi ('in, with, by means of, concerning') attached to the relative/indefinite pronoun mā ('what, that which'). Both elements are invariable, so the phrase carries no case ending. A word governed by the preposition bi is understood to be in the genitive relationship.

24.meaning: You (all) do / work / act — to carry out deeds or labor.
24.grammar: A present-tense verb (Form I). The 'ta-' prefix with the '-ūna' ending marks the second-person masculine plural ('you all'). The '-ūna' (with final 'n') is the indicative form, marking a plain ongoing or habitual statement.
24.root: ع-م-ل (ʿ-m-l) — to do, work, act; deeds

25.meaning: 'Fully aware / All-Aware' — one who knows the inner reality and hidden details of things through intimate, expert knowledge. As a divine attribute it denotes Allah's perfect awareness of all that is concealed.
25.grammar: An intensive adjective on the faʿīl pattern, conveying a deep, thorough quality ('thoroughly aware'). The ending -un is the indefinite nominative (tanwīn ḍamm): it marks an indefinite noun/adjective in the nominative case, the form used for the subject of a sentence or a predicate.

1.meaning: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that' — pointing to something regarded as distant or elevated, as opposed to 'this' (hadha) for what is near. It singles out a masculine singular thing and lends it a sense of distinction or loftiness.
1.grammar: A demonstrative for a masculine singular referent at a distance. The -ka ending is an address particle directed at a single male listener; it does not change for case. The whole word stays fixed in form regardless of its grammatical position.

2.meaning: A two-part connector meaning 'because / by reason of the fact that'. It combines the preposition 'with/by' and anna ('that…'), together introducing a cause or explanation for what precedes.
2.grammar: The preposition bi- ('with/by') attached to the emphatic particle anna ('that…'). anna introduces and stresses a following statement and grammatically puts the noun after it into the accusative; the pairing as a whole signals 'because / due to the fact that'.

3.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
3.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

4.meaning: 'He' — the standalone (independent) pronoun for a single masculine person or thing, used for emphasis or to stand as the subject on its own.
4.grammar: An independent (detached) personal pronoun, third-person masculine singular. It does not take case endings; its fixed final -a is part of the word. It serves to name or emphasize the subject ('He is the one who…').

5.meaning: 'The truth / the reality; what is right, real, and rightfully due.' A weighty noun meaning that which is firmly true and real, as opposed to falsehood; it also carries the senses of a rightful claim, a duty owed, and justice. With the article it denotes 'the Truth' in a definite, absolute sense.
5.grammar: A definite noun: the prefix al- ('the') plus the stem. The final -u ending is the nominative case, typically used for the subject of a sentence or for a word identifying what something is (as in 'X is the truth').
5.root: ح-ق-ق (ḥ-q-q) — truth, reality, rightness; that which is established and rightfully due

6.meaning: And that — a linking expression introducing a fact or clause ('and that …'); it combines 'and' with a particle that sets up and emphasises the statement that follows.
6.grammar: A connective made of wa- ('and') plus anna ('that'). Anna introduces a noun clause — a fact being asserted — and gives it emphasis, roughly 'and (it is the case) that …'. As a governing particle, anna puts the noun right after it into the accusative case.

7.meaning: A versatile word most often meaning 'what' or 'that which' — it can introduce a relative idea ('the thing that…'), ask a question ('what?'), or in other uses serve as a negating particle. Its core job is to stand in for an unspecified thing.
7.grammar: A fixed (indeclinable) particle with no case ending; its sense is set by context. As a relative it means 'that which' and needs a following clause; as an interrogative it means 'what?'.

8.meaning: 'They call / invite / summon' — to call upon, invite, or summon (also to pray to or call out to); a present-tense verb with a masculine-plural subject.
8.grammar: A present-tense (imperfect) verb, 3rd-person masculine plural ('they call/invite'). The ya- prefix with the full -ūna ending marks 'they (men) do' and shows the indicative mood — the plain statement form ('they do'), with its final nūn intact (contrast the jussive/subjunctive, where it drops).
8.root: د-ع-و (d-ʿ-w) — to call, summon, invite, pray

9.meaning: 'From, out of': a preposition marking the starting point or source of something — the origin from which a thing comes, or a part taken from a whole.
9.grammar: A preposition expressing origin, source, or partition ('from, out of, some of'). A noun governed by min stands in the genitive relationship and would typically take an -i type ending. The particle itself is invariable.

10.meaning: besides Him / other than Him

parts.en: besides / other than (genitive noun used as preposition)
Him (3rd person masculine singular possessive suffix)

10.grammar: noun used as preposition, genitive case (object of preposition مِن), with 3rd person masculine possessive suffix هِ; phrase مِن دُونِهِ = besides Him / other than Him

11.meaning: A noun/active participle meaning 'the false, the vain, that which is baseless or void.' It denotes falsehood — what has no reality, no truth, and no lasting substance, the opposite of what is true and established.
11.grammar: The article al- makes it definite ('the'). The word is an active participle on the pattern fā'il ('that which is …'), here 'that which is null/false.' The final -u is the nominative ending, which typically marks the word as the subject (the doer) of a sentence.
11.root: ب-ط-ل (b-ṭ-l) — to be false, vain, void, come to nothing

12.meaning: And that — a linking expression introducing a fact or clause ('and that …'); it combines 'and' with a particle that sets up and emphasises the statement that follows.
12.grammar: A connective made of wa- ('and') plus anna ('that'). Anna introduces a noun clause — a fact being asserted — and gives it emphasis, roughly 'and (it is the case) that …'. As a governing particle, anna puts the noun right after it into the accusative case.

13.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
13.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

14.meaning: 'He' — the standalone (independent) pronoun for a single masculine person or thing, used for emphasis or to stand as the subject on its own.
14.grammar: An independent (detached) personal pronoun, third-person masculine singular. It does not take case endings; its fixed final -a is part of the word. It serves to name or emphasize the subject ('He is the one who…').

15.meaning: 'the Most High / the Exalted' — lofty, elevated, supreme in rank and majesty above all else. As a divine name it affirms transcendence and highest dignity.
15.grammar: A definite adjective/noun in an intensive pattern ('the Most High'). The -u ending is nominative, the case typically used for the subject of a sentence or for an appositive descriptive title attached to such a subject.
15.root: ع-ل-و (ʿ-l-w) — to be high, lofty, exalted

16.grammar: adjective used as Divine Name, intensive form (فَعِيل pattern), masculine singular, nominative case, definite with article; one of the Names of Allah
16.root: ك-ب-ر (k-b-r) — to be great, to be large

1.meaning: 'Did not…?' — a particle combining a question with negation, used to ask 'Have I/has he not…?', often expecting agreement or serving as a gentle reminder.
1.grammar: An interrogative prefix 'a-' ('?') joined to the negation 'lam'. 'lam' negates a verb and places it firmly in the past ('did not'), and grammatically puts the following present-tense verb into the jussive (clipped) form. Together they form a rhetorical or confirming question.

2.meaning: You see, perceive, or take notice; to observe with the eye, or by extension to come to know or consider. Often used to draw attention, as in 'have you considered…?'
2.grammar: A present-tense verb addressed to a single male 'you,' marked by the 'ta-' prefix. The root's weak final letter has dropped, leaving the short final -a; this shortened form is the jussive/apocopated form, which appears after certain particles (such as 'did not' or in questions like 'have you not seen?').
2.root: ر-أ-ي (r-ʾ-y) — to see, perceive, consider, form an opinion

3.meaning: An emphatic particle meaning 'that' (as in 'I know that...') or 'indeed/surely.' It introduces a statement and gives it certainty and emphasis, presenting what follows as an established fact.
3.grammar: An emphatic particle that introduces a noun-clause ('that...'). It puts the following noun into the accusative case and lends the whole statement a sense of certainty and assertion. It typically comes after verbs of knowing, saying, or informing.

4.meaning: The ship, ark, or vessel — a boat that travels on water. The noun is unusual in that the same form serves for both singular ('a ship') and plural ('ships').
4.grammar: A definite noun ('the …'). The final -a is the accusative ending, which generally marks a noun as the direct object of a verb or the subject after certain particles.
4.root: ف-ل-ك (f-l-k) — that which is round or revolves; hence both a sailing ship and the orbiting celestial sphere.

5.meaning: A verb 'it flows, runs, streams' — used of water and rivers moving along, and of things that run or course freely. It describes continuous, ongoing motion.
5.grammar: A present/imperfect verb, 3rd person feminine singular. The ta- prefix here marks a feminine 'it/she' subject. The verb describes an ongoing or habitual action: 'it flows / keeps flowing.'
5.root: ج-ر-ي (j-r-y) — to flow, run, stream

6.meaning: A preposition meaning 'in,' 'within,' or 'inside.' It locates something inside a place, a time, a state, or a matter — physically or figuratively (e.g. 'in' a condition or 'concerning' a matter).
6.grammar: A preposition. It is invariable (it does not change form) and places the following noun into the genitive case, indicating containment or location 'in / within' something.

7.meaning: The sea, the great body of salt water; figuratively any vast expanse of water.
7.grammar: A definite singular masculine noun ('the …'). The final -i ending is genitive, the case taken after a preposition or when a noun is possessed by a preceding noun ('… of the sea').

8.meaning: by the grace of / with the blessing of
8.grammar: prepositional phrase: preposition بِ + noun نِعْمَة (blessing) in genitive construct state; the ة becomes تِ in construct before the following possessive
8.root: ن-ع-م (n-ʿ-m) — blessing, bounty; to be comfortable

9.meaning: The proper name of the One God in Arabic: 'Allah' — the unique, absolute Deity, the sole object of worship, beside whom there is no other.
9.grammar: This is a proper name. The '-i' ending is the genitive case, the form a noun takes after a preposition or when linked to a preceding noun ('… of Allah', or 'besides Allah'). The leading 'al-' is fused into the name itself.

10.meaning: so that He may show you

parts.en: so that / in order to (purpose preposition)
He shows / makes see (subjunctive, Form IV)
you (2nd person masculine plural object pronoun)

10.grammar: purpose clause: preposition لِ (so that) + verb imperfect subjunctive Form IV (أَرَى), 3rd person masculine singular + 2nd person plural object pronoun كُمْ

11.meaning: A preposition whose core sense is 'from' — marking a starting point or origin (from a place, time, or source). It also commonly means 'of' or 'among' (part of a larger whole) and 'than' in comparisons.
11.grammar: A preposition. It is indeclinable and governs the following noun in the genitive case. Its primary force is point of origin ('starting from'), and it frequently expresses partitioning ('some of / part of').

12.meaning: 'His signs / His verses.' The plural of a word meaning a sign, token, or mark that points to a greater reality — also used for the verses of revelation — here joined to 'his'.
12.grammar: A sound feminine plural ('signs') with an attached possessive 'his'. The -i ending is the genitive case, the form this plural takes when it follows a preposition or is linked as the object of a possessor; the -hi ('his') marks ownership: 'his signs'.
12.root: أ-ي-ي (ʾ-y-y) — a sign, token, mark; a verse of revelation

13.meaning: An emphasis particle placed at the start of a statement to strengthen and affirm it — roughly 'indeed', 'truly', 'verily'. It assures the listener that what follows is certainly the case.
13.grammar: An emphasising particle that introduces a nominal sentence. It puts the following noun (its subject) into the accusative case, while the predicate that comes after stays nominative. Its function is to affirm and stress the whole statement; it carries no tense or person of its own.

14.meaning: A preposition meaning 'in,' 'within,' or 'inside.' It locates something inside a place, a time, a state, or a matter — physically or figuratively (e.g. 'in' a condition or 'concerning' a matter).
14.grammar: A preposition. It is invariable (it does not change form) and places the following noun into the genitive case, indicating containment or location 'in / within' something.

15.meaning: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that' — pointing to something regarded as distant or elevated, as opposed to 'this' (hadha) for what is near. It singles out a masculine singular thing and lends it a sense of distinction or loftiness.
15.grammar: A demonstrative for a masculine singular referent at a distance. The -ka ending is an address particle directed at a single male listener; it does not change for case. The whole word stays fixed in form regardless of its grammatical position.

16.meaning: Surely signs, tokens, or clear indications; evidences that point to a greater truth. The prefixed lām adds emphasis ('surely / indeed').
16.grammar: An emphatic particle 'la-' ('surely') joined to an indefinite feminine plural noun ('signs'). The -āt- is the sound feminine plural marker; the final -in (nunation) marks it indefinite. For this plural pattern the -in form serves for both the accusative and the genitive case.

17.meaning: For every, for each, belonging to all of. Combines the preposition 'for/to' with the word for 'every/all.'
17.grammar: The preposition li- ('for/to') joined to kull ('every/each/all'). The -i ending on kull is genitive, the case required after a preposition. The combination conveys 'for every / to each.'

18.meaning: One who is intensely and persistently patient — greatly enduring, steadfast in hardship. The form stresses an abundant, characteristic patience, not just an occasional act.
18.grammar: An emphatic 'doer' noun (the intensive paradigm that means 'one who does much/repeatedly'). The -in ending marks the genitive case with indefiniteness ('a deeply patient one'); the genitive usually links to a preceding noun or follows a preposition.

19.meaning: One who is deeply and constantly thankful — abundantly grateful. The form emphasizes a settled, characteristic gratitude that expresses thanks fully and often.
19.grammar: An intensive 'doer' noun meaning 'one who is much/often thankful.' The -in ending marks the genitive case with indefiniteness ('a deeply grateful one'); the genitive usually links to a preceding noun or follows a preposition.

1.meaning: 'And when...' — a linking phrase joining 'and' to 'when', used to introduce a circumstance or a recurring situation: 'and whenever / and at the time that...'.
1.grammar: The connector wa- ('and') attached to idhā ('when'). Idhā is a particle pointing to a time or condition, generally referring to something expected or recurring in the future ('when / whenever' it happens), and it normally introduces a following clause that states what occurs at that time.

2.meaning: A past-tense verb meaning 'it covered them / engulfed them / overwhelmed them,' picturing something spreading over people so as to envelop or veil them completely, with an attached object 'them.'
2.grammar: A completed (past-tense) verb in the 'he/it' form. The attached -hum is the object pronoun 'them,' so the whole word means 'it covered them.' The verb itself carries no separate subject ending because the doer is built into the third-person singular form.
2.root: غ-ش-ي (gh-sh-y) — to cover over, envelop, overwhelm

3.meaning: a wave
3.grammar: noun, masculine singular, nominative case with tanwīn (indefinite), subject of its clause or predicate

4.meaning: like canopies / as dark clouds

parts.en: canopies / dark clouds / awnings (genitive, definite, plural)

4.grammar: prepositional phrase: preposition كَ + noun الظُّلَل (broken plural of ظُلَّة meaning canopy, awning, cloud-shadow) in genitive case with definite article

5.meaning: They called/invoked — to call upon, summon, or appeal to someone, especially calling on Allah in prayer and supplication. The root spans calling, inviting, and praying.
5.grammar: Past-tense verb. The plural ending (-aw, written with the silent final alif) marks a third-person masculine plural subject ('they'): 'they called / invoked'.
5.root: د-ع-و (d-ʿ-w) — to call, summon, invoke, pray

6.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
6.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

7.meaning: Being sincere and single-hearted — making one's devotion purely and exclusively for Allah, with no rival motive mixed in. It describes a group of people in this state.

parts.en: one who is sincere / devotes purely

7.grammar: A Form IV active participle (pattern muf'il, from the verb akhlaṣa 'to make pure / devote sincerely'), describing the one who purifies and dedicates his devotion. It is in the sound masculine plural, and the '-īna' ending marks the accusative/genitive (object or oblique) case, so it describes a plural group as those who make their worship purely and sincerely for Allah.
7.root: خ-ل-ص (kh-l-ṣ) — to be pure, sincere, unmixed

8.meaning: To him / for him / he has — the preposition 'to/for' fused with a pronoun meaning 'him.' It expresses belonging, benefit, or possession (something is 'his' or done 'for him').
8.grammar: A preposition 'li-/la-' ('to, for') with the attached 3rd-person masculine singular pronoun 'him.' The pairing means 'to him' or 'for him' and often conveys possession ('he has …') or that an action is directed toward his benefit or detriment.
8.root: — (particle with attached pronoun; no triliteral root)

9.meaning: Religion, the way of life and obedience owed to Allah — encompassing faith, devotion, the binding code of worship, and the final reckoning. A weighty term broader than the English 'religion'.
9.grammar: A definite noun ('the dīn') with the article 'al-' (its 'l' assimilating into the following 'd'). The final '-a' is the accusative case, the form a noun takes when it is the direct object of a verb or otherwise governed into that state.

10.meaning: A connector meaning 'then, when' — it joins to what came before ('then/so') and sets up a 'when…' clause whose outcome follows. It frames a moment: 'and then, at the point when…'.
10.grammar: A compound of the connecting particle fa- ('then/so', linking to the preceding statement) and lammā, a particle meaning 'when' that introduces a past circumstance and leads the listener to expect a following result clause.

11.meaning: He delivers them / rescues them

parts.en: He delivered / rescued (past tense, Form II)
them (3rd person masculine plural object pronoun)

11.grammar: verb, perfect tense, Form II (نَجَّى), 3rd person masculine singular; with 3rd person masculine plural object pronoun هُمْ
11.root: ن-ج-و (n-j-w) — to be saved, to rescue, to deliver

12.meaning: 'To / toward / up to' — a preposition marking the endpoint, goal, or limit of an action or motion: the direction something moves toward or the boundary at which it stops.
12.grammar: An invariable preposition. It has no case ending of its own but puts the noun that follows it into the genitive ('of / to' state). It indicates direction toward, or the terminal limit of, something.

13.meaning: The dry land — solid ground as opposed to the sea; the terrain one travels on foot.
13.grammar: A definite noun with the article al- ('the'). The -i ending marks the genitive case, the form taken after a preposition or when the word is linked to a preceding noun in an 'of …' relationship. The doubled r (shadda) is part of the stem.

14.meaning: "so / and among them / of them (there are)" — the preposition min ('from, among, of') with the pronoun 'them', expressing 'among them' or 'some of them', introduced by 'so/and'.
14.grammar: A connective particle plus a preposition with an attached pronoun. Fa- means 'so/and then', linking to what precedes. Min ('from/among') takes no case ending; the suffix -hum is 'them' (third-person masculine plural). The phrase often introduces a partition ('among them are…').

15.meaning: moderate / just / keeping to the middle course

parts.en: moderate / keeping to the middle course (nominative, indefinite)

15.grammar: active participle, Form VIII (اقتصد), masculine singular, nominative case with tanwīn; meaning one who follows the middle/just course, one who is moderate
15.root: ق-ص-د (q-ṣ-d) — to be moderate, to aim, to intend

16.meaning: A connective phrase meaning 'and what' or 'and that which'. It adds a further item and points to an unspecified thing or category.
16.grammar: The connector wa ('and') joined to mā ('what, that which'). Here mā functions as a relative/indefinite pronoun ('that which'); the same word can elsewhere serve as a negator. It is invariable and takes no case ending.

17.grammar: verb, imperfect tense, Form I (جَحَدَ), 3rd person masculine singular, indicative; meaning to deny despite knowing the truth
17.root: ج-ح-د (j-ḥ-d) — to deny, to repudiate, to disavow

18.meaning: By/in Our signs. Āyāt is the plural of āya — a sign, token, or evidence. Signs are pointers that indicate a greater reality. With the prefixed particle and pronoun it means 'with/in Our signs'.
18.grammar: A plural noun preceded by the preposition bi- ('with, in, by'), which requires the following noun to take the -i (genitive) ending. The attached -nā means 'our' when joined to a noun. The genitive here is governed by the preposition.

19.meaning: A particle of exception meaning 'except,' 'save,' or 'only.' It carves out something from a preceding general statement — most often a preceding negation — so that the excepted item alone is affirmed, giving the strong sense 'none … but' or 'nothing other than.'
19.grammar: An exceptive particle (originally a fusion of 'in' + 'lā'). It is invariable — it has no case ending and does not change form. It introduces the item being excepted from, or restricted within, the preceding statement.

20.meaning: A noun meaning 'all, every, each, the whole of.' It expresses totality — when joined to a following noun it means 'every (one)' or 'the entirety of' that thing.
20.grammar: A noun of totality with the final -u ending (nominative). The -u typically marks it as the subject or the thing being spoken about. It normally attaches to a following noun to mean 'every / all of' it.

21.grammar: intensive adjective (فَعَّال pattern), masculine singular, genitive case with tanwīn; meaning one who is deeply treacherous, a great betrayer
21.root: خ-ت-ر (kh-t-r) — to be treacherous, to betray

22.grammar: intensive adjective (فَعُول pattern), masculine singular, genitive case with tanwīn; meaning extremely ungrateful or one who persistently disbelieves
22.root: ك-ف-ر (k-f-r) — to disbelieve, to be ungrateful

1.meaning: 'O…!' — a compound vocative expression used to call out and summon an audience before addressing them. It fuses the call-particle 'yā' ('O') with a noun that means 'the one(s) addressed,' yielding an emphatic 'O you…!' that introduces direct address.
1.grammar: A vocative (calling) construction. 'Yā' is the particle for calling out; 'ayyu' carries a nominative '-u' as the one being summoned; 'hā' is an attention-drawing particle. Together they function as 'O you…!,' setting up the noun of address that follows.

2.meaning: 'The people / mankind' — human beings collectively, people in general, humanity.
2.grammar: A collective noun with the definite article al- ('the'); the article's 'l' assimilates into the following 'n' (al-nās → an-nās). The -u ending marks the nominative case — the case used for the subject of a sentence or the basic naming form of a noun.
2.root: ن-و-س / أ-ن-س (n-w-s / ʾ-n-s) — humankind, people, sociability

3.meaning: Be mindful and wary of — guard yourselves by placing a protective barrier between yourselves and harm or wrongdoing. This is the verb of taqwā: God-conscious caution that shields one from what is forbidden.
3.grammar: A command (imperative) addressed to a group ('you all'). The -ū ending directs the order to a masculine plural 'you.' Built on a reflexive pattern (Form VIII), it conveys 'protect yourselves / be on guard.'

4.meaning: Your Lord — the Master, Sustainer, and Nurturer who creates, owns, and cares for you, guiding His servants to completion. "Rabb" carries the joined senses of owner, sustainer, and the one who lovingly brings to maturity, here addressed to a group.
4.grammar: A masculine singular noun with an attached possessive "your" (plural addressee). The -a before the pronoun is the accusative case, which generally marks the word as the object of a verb (the thing being acted upon).
4.root: ر-ب-ب (r-b-b) — to nurture, sustain, master, bring to completion

5.meaning: and fear
5.grammar: verb, imperative mood, Form I (خَشِيَ), 2nd person masculine plural (وا suffix); ا is prosthetic hamzah
5.root: خ-ش-ي (kh-sh-y) — to fear, to be in awe of

6.meaning: A day; a defined stretch of time. Often used for a momentous appointed day such as a day of judgement or reckoning.
6.grammar: A singular masculine noun, indefinite ('a day'). The -an ending (tanwīn fatḥa) is the indefinite accusative case, which typically marks the object of a verb or a noun otherwise governed in the accusative.

7.meaning: 'Not' — a particle of negation. Depending on context it denies a present fact, forbids an action, or rules something out ('do not / there is no').
7.grammar: A negating particle, 'not / no'. It is used to deny or prohibit — negating present-tense statements, expressing 'there is no...', or, with a command form, forbidding an action ('do not...').

8.meaning: "He rewards / requites / repays" — to give back a fitting return for deeds, whether reward or recompense. The verb jazā means to recompense, to pay back what is due for an action.
8.grammar: This is a present/future-tense verb. The ya- prefix marks a third-person masculine singular subject ("he"), so it means "he rewards/requites." The final long -ī belongs to the verb's stem (a verb whose root ends in a weak letter).
8.root: ج-ز-ي (j-z-y) — to recompense, reward, requite, pay back what is due

9.meaning: a father
9.grammar: active participle used as noun, Form I (وَلَدَ), masculine singular, nominative case with tanwīn (indefinite), subject of the conditional clause
9.root: و-ل-د (w-l-d) — to beget, to give birth; parent

10.meaning: A preposition meaning 'on behalf of,' 'for,' 'about,' or 'away from.' It often conveys removing a burden from someone or acting in their place.

parts.en: on behalf of / for / away from

10.grammar: A preposition (a linking particle). It governs the noun that follows it, putting that noun into the genitive case. It does not change form.

11.meaning: his son / his child

parts.en: his (3rd person masculine singular possessive suffix)

11.grammar: noun, masculine singular, accusative case (direct object) in construct with 3rd person masculine possessive suffix هِ; referring to the son
11.root: و-ل-د (w-l-d) — to beget, to give birth; child, offspring

12.meaning: And not / but not — a connective 'and' joined to a negating particle that rules out or forbids what follows.
12.grammar: 'wa' is 'and'. 'lā' is a negating particle; placed before a verb of command it expresses prohibition ('do not ...'), and before other verbs/nouns it expresses negation ('not ...'). It carries no case ending.

13.meaning: A noun meaning 'the father' — literally 'the one for whom (a child) is born', the male parent on whose account offspring come into being. A passive participle ('one to whom birth is given') used as a term for the father.

parts.en: the one for whom a child is born (the father)

13.grammar: A noun with the -un ending, which is nominative and indefinite, typically marking the subject of a sentence. The maC-ū-C shape is a passive participle pattern, literally 'one to whom (birth) is given'; paired with a following 'for him', it designates the father — the parent for whom a child is born.
13.root: و-ل-د (w-l-d) — to give birth, to beget; offspring

14.meaning: 'He' — the standalone (independent) pronoun for a single masculine person or thing, used for emphasis or to stand as the subject on its own.
14.grammar: An independent (detached) personal pronoun, third-person masculine singular. It does not take case endings; its fixed final -a is part of the word. It serves to name or emphasize the subject ('He is the one who…').

15.meaning: avails / compensates
15.grammar: active participle, Form I (جَزَى), masculine singular, genitive case with tanwīn (منقوص — defective noun with final ي elided in indefinite genitive/accusative); meaning one who compensates or renders adequate
15.root: ج-ز-ي (j-z-y) — to compensate, to requite, to avail

16.meaning: A preposition meaning 'on behalf of,' 'for,' 'about,' or 'away from.' It often conveys removing a burden from someone or acting in their place.

parts.en: on behalf of / for / away from

16.grammar: A preposition (a linking particle). It governs the noun that follows it, putting that noun into the genitive case. It does not change form.

parts.en: his (3rd person masculine singular possessive suffix)

17.grammar: active participle used as noun, Form I (وَلَدَ), masculine singular, genitive case in construct with 3rd person masculine possessive suffix هِ
17.root: و-ل-د (w-l-d) — to beget, to give birth; parent

18.meaning: A thing; something or anything. With a negation it commonly amounts to 'nothing at all.'
18.grammar: A singular masculine noun, indefinite ('a thing'). The -an ending (tanwīn fatḥa) is the indefinite accusative, often used here as an object or an adverbial 'in any respect / at all.'

19.meaning: An emphasis particle placed at the start of a statement to strengthen and affirm it — roughly 'indeed', 'truly', 'verily'. It assures the listener that what follows is certainly the case.
19.grammar: An emphasising particle that introduces a nominal sentence. It puts the following noun (its subject) into the accusative case, while the predicate that comes after stays nominative. Its function is to affirm and stress the whole statement; it carries no tense or person of its own.

20.meaning: 'a promise / pledge' — a binding assurance of something to come; here as a noun naming the thing pledged or the act of pledging.
20.grammar: A verbal noun with the -a (accusative) ending, which typically marks it as a direct object or as an emphatic inner object reinforcing a verb of the same meaning ('a promise [truly promised]'). It names the act/content of promising.
20.root: و-ع-د (w-ʿ-d) — to promise, pledge, give an assurance

21.meaning: The proper name of the One God in Arabic: 'Allah' — the unique, absolute Deity, the sole object of worship, beside whom there is no other.
21.grammar: This is a proper name. The '-i' ending is the genitive case, the form a noun takes after a preposition or when linked to a preceding noun ('… of Allah', or 'besides Allah'). The leading 'al-' is fused into the name itself.

22.meaning: 'Truth, reality, a rightful due' — that which is firmly real, correct, and established; also a right or claim that is owed. As a descriptor it means 'true, real, well-founded.'
22.grammar: An indefinite noun. The -un ending (nominative with tanwīn, the 'n' sound) is the form a noun takes as the subject or as the completing word of a statement ('is true/real').
22.root: ح-ق-ق (ḥ-q-q) — truth, right, reality, what is due

23.meaning: A two-part word: the connective particle 'fa-' meaning 'so', 'then', or 'therefore' (drawing a consequence from what precedes), joined to 'lā', the particle of negation/prohibition. Together they convey 'so do not …' or 'so there is no …'.
23.grammar: 'fa-' is a connector that links a clause to what came before and often signals a result or consequence. 'lā' is a negating particle; placed before a present-tense verb it commonly forms a prohibition ('do not …') or a simple negation ('not'). It carries no ending of its own.

24.meaning: so let it not deceive you all

parts.en: let it not deceive (emphatic jussive, Form I)
you (all) (2nd person masculine plural object pronoun)

24.grammar: verb, imperfect jussive with emphatic nūn (نون التوكيد الثقيلة), Form I (غَرَّ), 3rd person feminine singular; with 2nd person masculine plural object pronoun; the ف before it (فَلَا) introduces prohibition

25.meaning: 'The life' — earthly existence, the span of living in this world. The word denotes life as the state of being alive, vitality, and the worldly life as a whole.
25.grammar: 'al-' is the definite article 'the'. The final '-u' is the nominative ending, which typically marks the word as the subject of a sentence (the one doing or being something), or as the predicate naming what something is.

26.grammar: adjective used as noun, feminine singular superlative (دُنْيَا = the nearest / lowest), genitive or accusative case (diptote), definite with article; refers to the present worldly life
26.root: د-ن-و (d-n-w) — to be near, to be low; the lower/nearer (world)

27.meaning: And not / but not — a connective 'and' joined to a negating particle that rules out or forbids what follows.
27.grammar: 'wa' is 'and'. 'lā' is a negating particle; placed before a verb of command it expresses prohibition ('do not ...'), and before other verbs/nouns it expresses negation ('not ...'). It carries no case ending.

28.meaning: and let it not deceive you

parts.en: let it not deceive (emphatic jussive, Form I, masculine)
you (2nd person masculine plural object pronoun)

28.grammar: verb, imperfect jussive with emphatic nūn (نون التوكيد الثقيلة), Form I (غَرَّ), 3rd person masculine singular; with 2nd person masculine plural object pronoun كُمْ

29.meaning: A phrase 'in Allah / by Allah', combining the preposition 'with/in/by' and the divine name Allah, the proper name of the One God.
29.grammar: The preposition bi- ('in, with, by means of') prefixed to the divine name Allah. A preposition always forces the following noun into the genitive case, which is why Allah here ends in -i. With verbs of believing, bi- conveys the object of faith — to believe IN.
29.root: — (Allah is the proper name of God and is not derived from a triliteral root in the usual sense)

30.grammar: intensive adjective (فَعُول pattern) used as noun, masculine singular, nominative case (subject of يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ), definite with article; refers to Satan (the Deceiver)

1.meaning: An emphasis particle placed at the start of a statement to strengthen and affirm it — roughly 'indeed', 'truly', 'verily'. It assures the listener that what follows is certainly the case.
1.grammar: An emphasising particle that introduces a nominal sentence. It puts the following noun (its subject) into the accusative case, while the predicate that comes after stays nominative. Its function is to affirm and stress the whole statement; it carries no tense or person of its own.

2.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
2.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.
2.root: — (proper name)

3.meaning: 'With him / in his keeping / that he has' — combining the locational word 'ind ('at, with, in the presence/possession of') with the pronoun 'him'. It conveys that something is held by, present with, or belongs to him.
3.grammar: 'ʿinda' is an adverb of place/possession that always governs a following word in the genitive; here it takes the attached pronoun -hu ('him/his'). The -a on 'ʿinda' is its fixed accusative-style ending as an adverbial. The pronoun -hu means the thing is located with, or owned by, a single male.

4.meaning: knowledge, knowing — sure awareness and understanding of something, the opposite of ignorance.
4.grammar: A noun meaning "knowledge." The final -u is the nominative ending, which generally marks the word as the subject of a sentence or the thing being identified; it also sets up a possessive link to a following noun ("the knowledge OF …").

5.meaning: The Hour — the appointed final time: the moment of the world's ending and the Resurrection. Though literally 'an hour' (a span of time), with the definite article it denotes that singular, decisive coming Hour.
5.grammar: A noun with the definite article 'al-' ('the'); the article's 'l' assimilates into the following 's' (heard as 'as-sāʿa'). The final -i is genitive — the case used when the word is possessed by a preceding noun ('… of the Hour') or follows a preposition.
5.root: س-و-ع (s-w-ʿ) — a passing moment or span of time; an 'hour'

6.meaning: And He sends down, causes to descend gradually or in stages — bringing something down from a higher place, often portion by portion.
6.grammar: The connector wa- ('and') with a present-tense verb in the intensive (Form II) pattern, which conveys sending down gradually or repeatedly. The yu- prefix marks a 'he/it' subject. The final '-u' ending is indicative, the mood for a plain statement of ongoing or habitual fact: 'and he sends down.'
6.root: ن-ز-ل (n-z-l) — to descend, come down, alight

7.meaning: the rain
7.grammar: noun, masculine singular, accusative case (direct object of يُنَزِّلُ), definite with article; referring to life-giving rain

8.meaning: And He knows — to have knowledge, perceiving and being fully aware of things.
8.grammar: A present-tense verb in the basic form I. The 'ya-' prefix marks a third-person masculine 'he' subject, and the final '-u' is the indicative mood, the plain form for an ongoing or habitual statement. Prefixed with 'wa' ('and').

9.meaning: A versatile word most often meaning 'what' or 'that which' — it can introduce a relative idea ('the thing that…'), ask a question ('what?'), or in other uses serve as a negating particle. Its core job is to stand in for an unspecified thing.
9.grammar: A fixed (indeclinable) particle with no case ending; its sense is set by context. As a relative it means 'that which' and needs a following clause; as an interrogative it means 'what?'.

10.meaning: A preposition meaning 'in,' 'within,' or 'inside.' It locates something inside a place, a time, a state, or a matter — physically or figuratively (e.g. 'in' a condition or 'concerning' a matter).
10.grammar: A preposition. It is invariable (it does not change form) and places the following noun into the genitive case, indicating containment or location 'in / within' something.

11.meaning: The wombs; by extension, ties of kinship and blood relationship. The plural of the noun for the womb, often evoking the bonds among relatives.
11.grammar: A broken (irregular) plural noun on the afʿāl pattern, made definite by the article al-. The final -i ending is genitive, the case typically used after a preposition, after an oath, or to link the word to a preceding noun in an 'of' relationship.

12.meaning: A connective phrase meaning 'and what' or 'and that which'. It adds a further item and points to an unspecified thing or category.
12.grammar: The connector wa ('and') joined to mā ('what, that which'). Here mā functions as a relative/indefinite pronoun ('that which'); the same word can elsewhere serve as a negator. It is invariable and takes no case ending.

13.meaning: knows / is aware

parts.en: it knows / you know (imperfect verb, feminine)

13.grammar: verb, imperfect tense, Form I (دَرَى), 3rd person feminine singular or 2nd person feminine singular, indicative; in construction with مَا (what) meaning 'knows not what'
13.root: د-ر-ي (d-r-y) — to know, to be aware of

14.meaning: A soul, self, or person — the inner self of a living being; by extension, an individual.
14.grammar: A singular feminine noun, indefinite ('a soul'). The -un ending (tanwīn ḍamma) is the indefinite nominative case, which typically marks the subject or doer.

15.meaning: 'What…?' — a question word asking about a thing or matter, used to inquire 'what is it that…?' It is formed by joining 'what' with the demonstrative 'that.'
15.grammar: An interrogative compound made of mā ('what') plus dhā ('that'), together meaning 'what is it that…?' It is an indeclinable question word — it has no case ending and keeps one fixed form, introducing a question about a thing.

16.meaning: He/it earns, acquires, gains — to gather to oneself, especially the consequences of one's own deeds, whether good or bad. The verb stresses what a person brings upon themselves by their actions.
16.grammar: A present/imperfect verb. The ta- prefix marks a third-person feminine singular subject ('she/it …') or a second-person masculine singular ('you …'); context decides which. The final -u is the indicative ('plain present') ending, signalling ongoing or habitual action: 'earns / is earning'.

17.meaning: 'Tomorrow', and more broadly 'the (coming) morning' or 'a day soon to come'. It points to the near future, the next day.
17.grammar: A noun used adverbially for time. The -an ending (with tanwīn, the doubled 'n' sound) marks it as indefinite and in the accusative state, which is the typical form for an adverb of time ('on the morrow, tomorrow').
17.root: غ-د-و (gh-d-w) — morning, the early part of the day, going forth in the morning

18.meaning: A compound: the connective 'and' joined to the particle mā. The particle mā is highly versatile — it can mean 'what / whatever' (introducing an indirect question or a relative clause, 'that which'), or it can function as a negation ('not'). Context determines which sense applies; the core idea is an open, unspecified 'what(ever)' or a flat denial.
18.grammar: Two indeclinable particles, so there is no case ending to mark. The wa- prefix is the simple connective 'and', linking what follows to what precedes. Mā itself does not change form: it serves either as an interrogative/relative ('what, that which') or as a negating word ('not').

parts.en: it knows / you know (imperfect verb, feminine)

19.grammar: verb, imperfect tense, Form I (دَرَى), 3rd person feminine singular or 2nd person feminine singular, indicative; in construction with مَا (what) meaning 'knows not what'
19.root: د-ر-ي (d-r-y) — to know, to be aware of

20.meaning: A soul, self, or person — the inner self of a living being; by extension, an individual.
20.grammar: A singular feminine noun, indefinite ('a soul'). The -un ending (tanwīn ḍamma) is the indefinite nominative case, which typically marks the subject or doer.

21.grammar: prepositional phrase: preposition بِ + interrogative/relative pronoun أَيّ in genitive construct state; the phrase بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ = in which land

22.grammar: noun, feminine singular, genitive case with tanwīn (indefinite); object of the interrogative pronoun أَيّ in the construction بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ

23.grammar: verb, imperfect tense, Form I (مَاتَ), 3rd person feminine singular (agreeing with نَفْس — soul, which is feminine), indicative; referring to the soul not knowing when it will die

24.meaning: An emphasis particle placed at the start of a statement to strengthen and affirm it — roughly 'indeed', 'truly', 'verily'. It assures the listener that what follows is certainly the case.
24.grammar: An emphasising particle that introduces a nominal sentence. It puts the following noun (its subject) into the accusative case, while the predicate that comes after stays nominative. Its function is to affirm and stress the whole statement; it carries no tense or person of its own.

25.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
25.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

26.meaning: An intensive adjective/name meaning 'All-Knowing / fully aware' — one whose knowledge is complete, deep, and all-encompassing; as a divine attribute it denotes Allah's perfect knowledge.
26.grammar: An intensive adjective (the pattern faʿīl conveys 'thoroughly, abundantly'). The ending -un is the indefinite nominative — the nominative case marks it as the subject or the quality being affirmed, and the -n (nunation) signals 'a / an', i.e. indefinite. So it reads '(is) all-knowing'.

27.meaning: Thoroughly aware, intimately acquainted — one who knows the inner reality of things, fully informed of even hidden matters. An intensive description of deep, expert knowledge.
27.grammar: A descriptive noun/adjective, 'fully aware.' The pattern (faʿīl) is intensive, conveying a deep, settled quality of knowing rather than a passing awareness. The ending -un is nominative (subject/predicate case) and indefinite — the doubled 'n' sound (tanwīn) corresponds to the lack of 'the'.
27.root: خ-ب-ر (kh-b-r) — knowledge of inner realities; being informed
